title: The One Where Ghazaal Turns 29

reasons.title: Your smile
reasons.text: I love your smile, because it somehow makes everything around it feel lighter.

reasons.title: Your laugh
reasons.text: I love your laugh, because once it starts, the whole moment becomes better.

reasons.title: Your warmth
reasons.text: I love how warm you are with people, even when you do not realise how much comfort you give them.

reasons.title: Ordinary days
reasons.text: I love that you make ordinary days feel like they mattered.

reasons.title: Your chaos
reasons.text: I love your little chaotic moments, because they make you even more you.

reasons.title: The way you care
reasons.text: I love the way you care, deeply and naturally, without needing attention for it.

reasons.title: How alive you make things feel
reasons.text: I love how beautiful you are, but even more than that, I love how alive you make everything feel.

reasons.title: Main-character energy
reasons.text: I love that you have this main-character energy without even trying.

reasons.title: Your reactions
reasons.text: I love the way you react to things, because even your small expressions are somehow unforgettable.

reasons.title: Simple plans
reasons.text: I love that being with you can make even the simplest plans feel exciting.

reasons.title: Your soft side
reasons.text: I love how soft and sweet you can be, especially in the little moments.

reasons.title: Your dramatic side
reasons.text: I love that you can also be funny and dramatic in the best possible way.

reasons.title: The room gets warmer
reasons.text: I love how you make places feel warmer just by being there.

reasons.title: Doing nothing together
reasons.text: I love that time with you never feels wasted, even when we are doing absolutely nothing.

reasons.title: Easy memories
reasons.text: I love how easy it is to make memories with you.

reasons.title: Small things become stories
reasons.text: I love the way you turn small things into stories worth remembering.

reasons.title: You make me try properly
reasons.text: I love that you make me want to do things properly — not halfway, not lazily, but with real effort.

reasons.title: Less overthinking, more feeling
reasons.text: I love that you are one of the few people who can make me overthink less and feel more.

reasons.title: Your heart
reasons.text: I love how much heart you have.

reasons.title: How you love your people
reasons.text: I love the way you love your people, because it says everything about who you are.

reasons.title: Softer and brighter
reasons.text: I love that life feels softer when you are close and brighter when you are happy.

reasons.title: You make me create
reasons.text: I love that even this whole episode exists because loving you makes me want to create things.

reasons.title: Naturally beautiful
reasons.text: I love how naturally beautiful you are, in the kind of way that goes way beyond looks.

reasons.title: Unforgettable
reasons.text: I love that even when you are not trying, you still end up being unforgettable.

reasons.title: All at once
reasons.text: I love how being with you can feel fun, calm, romantic, and chaotic all at once.

reasons.title: So many happy memories
reasons.text: I love that when I think about happy memories, somehow you are in so many of them.

reasons.title: Lucky
reasons.text: I love that you make me feel lucky in a way that is hard to explain but impossible to ignore.

reasons.title: Easy, natural, right
reasons.text: I love that loving you feels easy, natural, and right.

reasons.title: You
reasons.text: More than anything, I love that you are you — and that gets to be my favourite part of the story.

pouyaFinalMessage:
Ghazaal,

This is The One Where You Turn 29.

A normal birthday message felt too small, so I made you an episode. Very normal behaviour from me, obviously.

But honestly, I wanted to make something that feels even a little bit like you: warm, funny, beautiful, emotional, a little dramatic in the best way, and impossible not to love.

You make ordinary days feel special. You make small moments feel like memories. You make rooms warmer just by being in them. And somehow, without even trying, you have become my favourite part of the story.

I love your laugh, your heart, your softness, your chaos, your kindness, and all the little things you probably do not even notice about yourself.

Happy 29th birthday, my love.

I hope this year gives you even a little bit of the happiness you give to the people around you.

And just so you know...

This is not the finale.

This is only Episode 1.

The big one is coming next year.
